page.notes: Two printed pages on one scan; both are single-column lists of titles, so each printed line is one <l>. The gutter markers (10, 20, 3°, 4°, 5°, 6°) are set beside the left page's lines 10 to 60 and are placed as notes there. The right page's first word "bularius" is a fragment cut off at the page edge. Doubtful readings: "Donatus spiritualis" (marked [?]); a few words such as "Delepultu-ra", "Chronica triplex", "Planctus" and "Tractar." are read from a small, dense print and may be misread. Hyphenated line-end words keep their printed hyphen. No catchword or signature is visible.
